text: Program Description Academic Year & Curriculum This is a 4-year program, 3 trimesters per academic year. Curriculum (160 Credits) Program Orientation The program aims to enable students to be proficient in Chinese language communication, to understand the essential knowledge in health management and thus to engage in health monitoring and consulting service. Main Courses · Intermediate Chinese Listening & Speaking · Intermediate Chinese Reading & Writing · Advanced Chinese · Basic Chinese of Traditional Chinese Medicine · Foundation of Disease · General Introduction to Traditional Chinese Medicine · Health Education · Health Management · Health Policy · History of Chinese Medicine · Design and Management of Healthy Diet · Nutritional Epidemiology · Nutrition Management in Clinical Practice Graduation and Academic Degree A Bachelor of Arts will be awarded upon completion of · Required credits of all courses in the teaching scheme (Attachment 1) · Pass of all examinations · New HSK 6≥180
